xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4301: Awareness feed: show transitions instead of a live conversation index; consolidate gauntlet lanes into one card per run

plan.title: Awareness feed: show transitions instead of a live conversation index; consolidate gauntlet lanes into one card per run
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Command Deck Awareness rail is flooded: the Chats source maps every non-archived conversation to a card dated by transcript mtime (lastActivityAt), polled every 30 s, so every working conversation and each gauntlet lane jumps to 'Just Now' and nothing ages out; the sequencer-runner singleton shows as a blank 'No messages yet' card; Project scope filters by issue id only, hiding issue-less lane conversations; the Git, Files and Comments tabs never show anything.
narratives.Proposal: Derive, don't store. Conversation entries are dated by lifecycle facts (createdAt/endedAt) in All and by recency in a 24 h-windowed Chats index; singleton agents are excluded; the status dot is derived from isWorking/pendingInputCount/sessionAlive. Lane rows collapse into one gauntlet_run entry per (projectKey, gauntletRun), built by a pure selector using the D10 lane-activity rule moved to @overdeck/contracts (laneActivityOf, also used by src/lib/lanes/views.ts); the card shows counts, the latest report/failure/end/launch and its time, opens the orchestrator, and fetches GET /api/lanes?run= only on expand. Per-issue activity collapses to one card with a step count. Project scope keeps conversations and runs in the Command Deck's resolved project set. Git/Files/Comments tabs are hidden. Docs updated in DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, reference/lanes.mdx and concepts.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Moving telemetry out of activity.entry at emit sites, the prdGate superseded-failure rule, and the one-merge-card rule (PAN-4306, blocked by PAN-4300)
- Fixing the dead-agent heartbeat_dead / status_changed loop (PAN-4300)
- Changing seedRecentActivity's 50-entry truncation or God View 'merges today'
- Any new table, column, stored status field, or server route
- Changing usePendingInputSubjects, DecisionsPanel or the Needs-you rows
- Grouping pre-pan-lane 'SB lane' conversations that lack gauntletRun
- Depending on the pan-gauntlet-loop skill's gauntlet/status.json
- Deleting useGitFeed.ts, GitFeedCard.tsx or their tests
- Changing pan lane list / GET /api/lanes output

autoDecisions.summary: Split Wanted item 4 (telemetry leaves activity.entry at emit sites) and its three ACs into sibling issue PAN-4306, blocked by PAN-4300.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names PAN-4300 as a prerequisite for item 4, and the emit sites span six more subsystems (cloister, agents, overdeck lib, server routes/main, CLI); the planning contract prefers independently shippable siblings over a mega-plan. Recorded as a comment on PAN-4301.

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation entries carry two clocks: timestamp = lifecycle fact (endedAt when ended, else createdAt) and recencyAt; the Chats tab re-dates to recencyAt.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires All to be dated by recorded facts while the review's Chats design is a recency index; one entry with both fields keeps a single mapper.

autoDecisions.summary: The All tab applies a 24 h window to every conversation entry, alive or not.
autoDecisions.rationale: All shows transitions; an alive conversation created days ago has no transition in the window and stays reachable in Chats and the Command Deck list.

autoDecisions.summary: Pending-input 'since' does not date conversation or run entries.
autoDecisions.rationale: The conversation row has pendingInputCount but no since; a waiting lane already has its own dated Needs-you row, and the run card shows it in counts and state.

autoDecisions.summary: Run cards group by the lane row's explicit projectKey; Project scope uses the Command Deck's existing projectConvIdSet.
autoDecisions.rationale: Lane launch always stores projectKey (launch.ts:333-334, :483); PAN-1577 requires one project resolver, which projectConvIdSet already applies.

autoDecisions.summary: Counts line is one aggregate 'roles · activities' line (e.g. '6 builders · 6 working').
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue AC text and fits the 320 px rail; the review's per-role breakdown was illustrative.

autoDecisions.summary: Per-issue activity collapse uses the newest entry's headline with a step count.
autoDecisions.rationale: The newest entry is the issue's current state; the merge-card rule needs emit-site issueIds and belongs to PAN-4306.

autoDecisions.summary: laneActivityOf and SINGLETON_AGENT_IDS share one new contracts module, packages/contracts/src/conversation-rows.ts, tested in packages/contracts/src/__tests__.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both classify conversation rows for server and frontend; pure-function tests belong beside the function, and views.test.ts runs unchanged as regression proof.

autoDecisions.summary: Hide the Git tab and stop merging useGitFeed; keep the hook and card files.
autoDecisions.rationale: git_operations has 0 rows ever; the 15 s poll feeds nothing; restoring it is a two-line change once a writer exists.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the sessionFeed tests to root package.json test:frontend-subset.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend tests (conventions.md); none of the sessionFeed tests are listed today, so the new behavior would otherwise never run in CI.

metadata.sizeJustification: The projection exceeds 25 files / 6 subsystems only through tests (11 files), three separately located doc files (each counted as its own subsystem), and root package.json for the CI subset. All source changes sit in components/sessionFeed plus one contracts module and two one-line consumers; the separable telemetry work was already split to PAN-4306. Further splitting would create siblings that all edit sessionFeed/types.ts and useMergedFeed.ts and serialize anyway.
